# GemGame: Match 3 Puzzle

> A cozy, handcrafted match 3 puzzle game for iPhone with a starlit garden meta-layer. Free to download, no ads, no pay-to-win, no forced purchases to progress.

GemGame is a casual match 3 puzzle game for iOS by indie developer George Wall. Swap six gem types plus striped, wrapped, and rainbow special gems into cascade combos, earn stars, and spend them restoring celestial garden districts. It includes daily rewards, a Celestial Pass reward track, mission contracts, boosters, on-demand hints, and Game Center leaderboards and achievements. Free with optional in-app purchases; no ads or third-party trackers; plays offline. iPhone / iOS only.
